name: Backoffice
description: Endpoints only Backoffice has, under the `/backoffice/` prefix. The system that shares the database answers 404 to these paths. They cover the import and export permissions of policies, passkeys, collection indexes, extension upload and environment sync.

operations.summary: List Import and Export Permissions
operations.description: The import and export permissions the caller may read.

query.name: fields
query.description: Control what fields are being returned in the object.

query.name: limit
query.description: A limit on the number of objects that are returned.

query.name: offset
query.description: How many items to skip when fetching data.

query.name: sort
query.description: How to sort the returned items. `sort` is a CSV of fields used to sort the fetched items. Sorting defaults to ascending (ASC) order but a minus sign (` - `) can be used to reverse this to descending (DESC) order. Fields are prioritized by their order in the CSV. You can also use a ` ? ` to sort randomly.

query.name: filter
query.description: Select items in collection by given conditions.

query.name: search
query.description: Filter by items that contain the given search query in one of their fields.

query.name: meta
query.description: What metadata to return in the response.

operations.accessNote: Per the caller's read and write permissions on the permission collection, like ordinary permissions.

operations.summary: List the Indexes of a Collection
operations.description: The indexes Backoffice created for the collection, with their status (`creating`, `ready`, `failed`). `meta` tells whether the database supports trigram indexes and building an index without locking the table.

operations.summary: Create an Index on a Collection
operations.description: Returns 202 at once; the index is built in the background, by default without locking the table. Follow its status with the list operation. Add `?concurrentIndexCreation=false` to build it with a table lock.

query.name: concurrentIndexCreation
query.description: `false` to build the index with a table lock.

fields.description: 1 to 8 fields with a real column.

type.description: `trigram` for `?search=` on Postgres, one string field.

responses.description: Accepted, the index is being built
Malformed body, a field without a column, or a type that does not fit

operations.summary: Delete an Index
operations.description: Drops the index in the database and its definition row.

operations.summary: Retrieve the Extension Upload Limit
operations.description: Maximum size of the `.tgz` package (from `FILES_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE`); `null` means no limit.

operations.summary: Install an Extension from an Uploaded Package
operations.description: Takes an `npm pack` package (`.tgz`) as multipart, checks its name, type and the sandbox mode of `MARKETPLACE_TRUST`, then installs it as an extension of source `upload`.

responses.description: Malformed package, a name already in use, not sandboxed, or over `EXTENSIONS_LIMIT`

operations.summary: Check Whether Passkeys Are On
operations.description: Returns the RP ID of the server. 404 when `PUBLIC_URL` is not an absolute URL with a domain name (passkeys off).

operations.summary: Start signing in with a passkey
operations.description: Returns WebAuthn options (a one-time challenge that expires after 5 minutes) for the browser to ask for a passkey.

operations.summary: Sign In with a Passkey
operations.description: Send the browser's answer to the challenge; returns tokens like a password sign-in, per `mode`.

responses.description: Invalid passkey, or the user may not sign in

operations.summary: List the Passkeys of the Current User
operations.description: Never returns the public key or the device's credential.

operations.summary: Save a New Passkey
operations.description: Send the browser's answer to the registration options with the passkey name. At most 10 passkeys per user.

operations.summary: Start adding a passkey
operations.description: Needs the user's current password; returns the WebAuthn options for the browser to create a passkey.

operations.summary: Rename a Passkey
Delete a Passkey of the Current User
List the Passkeys of a User
Delete a Passkey of a User
operations.description: For a user who lost a device; an admin cannot add or rename someone else's passkeys.

operations.summary: Retrieve the Version Details for Sync
operations.description: The Backoffice version, the compatible version, the database type and the migrations run. Two environments sync only when these match.

operations.summary: Read the Configuration State
operations.description: The configuration of the chosen groups (data model, flows, access, settings...). The target environment calls this operation on the source environment when comparing.

query.name: groups
query.description: The groups to read, comma separated; empty means every group.

operations.summary: Compare the Configuration with a Source Environment
operations.description: The server calls the source environment with the URL and static admin token in the request body (never stored), compares every configuration row and returns the status of each row with a hash of the comparison.

token.description: Static token of an admin at the source.

groups.description: The groups to compare; empty means every group.

responses.description: Blocked URL, the source does not answer, or the versions or migrations differ

operations.summary: Apply the Selected Rows
operations.description: Compares again under the lock, refuses when either side changed (another hash), then writes the chosen rows in one transaction. An error part way writes no row.

token.description: Static token of an admin at the source.

selected.description: IDs of the rows to apply.

responses.description: Outdated comparison, missing dependency, or the change would remove the caller's admin access

error.description: Error raised while building the index.

missing.description: A `ready` row whose index is no longer in the database.

backed_up.description: The passkey is synced to other devices.

transports.description: How the browser talks to the device.

permissions.description: Row filter of what may be imported or exported.

fields.description: The fields that may be imported or exported.

options.description: Options, e.g. the allowed file formats.
